So there’s a lot of things in the set that are tracks that help bring the space alive and surprise us a bit."}}, {"item_id": "article:87a15e7d18f2224f606da812", "version_id": "d432f3622ec222a34fa36e78", "locator": {"type": "text", "quote": "The Bard's tragedy gets blasted into orbit, transformed into a cosmic Glam rock comedy featuring norse gods, gladiator pits, space misfits and a golden robot.Containing adult language, puppet violence and at least one song that Shakespeare definitely didn't write, it is the ultimate treat for fans of Operation Mincemeat, Avenue Q and Forbidden Planet.Lewis Aves.It's Shakespeare. At what exact moment did you say to yourself, \"This needs space Vikings, violent puppets, and a David Bowie-inspired glam rock soundtrack\"?It hit us when we realized that the high-stakes melodrama and cosmic angst of Shakespeare’s original play actually mirror the theatricality of 1970s glam rock. They add an element of pure visual fun that contrasts brilliantly with the dramatic storyline.The show enjoyed a sold-out run with Open Door Theatre in Norwich in 2025 before making the leap to London.
